PRINCIPAL'S DESK
At the very outset, I 
			welcome you to the West Silchar College family, Barjatrapur, Cachar. 
			West Silchar College is the first institution of higher education in 
			the greater west Silchar area across up to Indo Bangladesh Border 
			inhabited by SC, ST, OBC and backward minority people. On behalf of 
			the college fraternity, I take the opportunity to owe my deep sense 
			of gratitude and thanks to all the stakeholders who had made this 
			possible and herewith us in those days of our initial journey 
			towards a dream higher educational institution. I also like to thank 
			all my respected guardians and well-wishers who have entrusted upon 
			us the academic responsibility of their children since the nascent 
			stage of the college and at the same time I must be grateful to the 
			members of the Governing Body who have encouraged us to carry out 
			this noble mission with their valuable suggestions from time to 
			time.

ABOUT US
West Silchar College
first started its journey in 1985 under Gauhati University. The 
			genesis of the College was the outcome of great thinking of 
			education loving people of greater West Silchar area to fulfill the 
			need of higher education of the common masses of this vast 
			downtrodden area across up to Indo-Bangladesh Border inhabitant 
			mainly by SC, ST, OBC and backward minority community people. With 
			the inception of Assam University in the year 1994, West Silchar 
			College automatically came under the domain of Assam University when 
			it was just to get affiliation of G. U. Now West Silchar College is 
			affiliated to Assam University, Silchar.
The pioneers of the 
			College were the education loving people of greater West Silchar 
			area, who with the co­operation of the common people under the 
			active guidance of the leaders like Lt. Altaf Hussain Mazumder, Lt. 
			A. F. G. Osmani, Lt. Dr. Luthfur Rahman Mazarbhuiya, Lt. Dr. Abdul 
			Matin Mazumder & Social worker Lt. Kamaruzzaman Choudhury, sowed the 
			seed of this rural College.
West Silchar College 
			is an Arts College. At present the College offers Three Year Degree 
			Course under Assam University, Silchar. Efforts are being made to 
			start Honours Course in subjects like English, Pol. Science, History 
			& Economics.
